items.prompt:
Read.

The theme is:
A) tyranny creates fear, not loyalty
B) critics are useless

items.answer: A) tyranny creates fear, not loyalty

solution.answer: A) tyranny creates fear, not loyalty

items.prompt:
A theme is usually a statement about:
A) life or people
B) page count
C) the author's age

Read.

An heir who scorned the poor came, after losing his wealth and living among them, to respect them.

The theme is:
A) wealth makes people kind
B) true worth is not tied to wealth
C) the poor are helpless
items.answer: B) true worth is not tied to wealth

steps: His change reveals the theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) true worth is not tied to wealth

items.prompt:
Read.

The general who won every war by any means ended his days despised, his victories remembered only as cruelty.

The BEST theme statement is:
A) Winning justifies any means.
B) Victory won through cruelty leaves no honor.
C) Generals live long lives.
items.answer: B) Victory won through cruelty leaves no honor.

steps: His end refines the theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Victory won through cruelty leaves no honor.

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary?
A) The settlers crossed the mountains.
B) The brave, noble settlers heroically conquered the brutal, unforgiving mountains.
C) They founded a town in the valley.
items.answer: B) The brave, noble settlers heroically conquered the brutal, unforgiving mountains.

steps: Loaded opinion words. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) The brave, noble settlers heroically conquered the brutal, unforgiving mountains.
